newsitem.title: USA: Fresh America Corp Q3 shr rises to $0.21.
newsitem.headline: Fresh America Corp Q3 shr rises to $0.21.

text.p: (in thousands except per share and club amounts)

(1) Prior to fiscal 1995, the company's fiscal year was a 52 or 53-week period ending on the first Sunday in January. Beginning with quarter ended March 31, 1995, the company's fiscal year is a 52 or 53-week period ending on the first Friday in January.

Nine months ended Sept. 29, 1995 is a 38-week and 5-day period as a result of this change. Nine months ended Sept. 27, 1996 is a 38-week period and quarters ended Sept. 29, 1995 and Sept. 27, 1996 are both 13-week periods.

(2) In November 1995, the company switched to its 5-year distribution agreement with Sam's Club. Under the new agreement, Sam's assumes all costs and liabilities related to operation of produce departments in each club, including all in-club personnel costs, merchandising and sales costs, customer returns and credits and product shrink.

Under the company's prior agreement with Sam's, it was responsible for such costs. Hence, the revised cost structure is not comparable with periods before November 1995 or with periods including November 1995.
Further, on Jan. 2, 1996, the company began operations from its Chicago and Cincinnati distribution centers and expanded the number of Sam's Clubs served from 216 clubs to 369 clubs.
